The '''Sith snake''' was a type of [[Snake/Legends|snake]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on a [[Mission to Moraband/Legends|mission to the planet]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] encountered Sith snakes.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
